name: Light-canvas AI demo: one camera over a UI canvas, an image that resolves, a step caption pill

rights.attribution: Unknown creator; supplied by the user as a private study reference.

brand_assets.description: A third-party coffee brand's name, product and photography in the generated image and the email

rights.notes: Rights unverified. Product demo showing two brands; reuse the canvas camera, the resolve and the caption pill with original UI.

analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, session B) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (40 frames), the transitions sheet (all 4 boundaries, every 2nd frame = 15 fps), the listen sheet (12 accent hits at -0.1/0/+0.1 s), and strips 10.80-13.20 s (10 fps) and 17.90-18.70 s (15 fps); automated audio and listen metrics (signal features; Windows desktop dictation for speech; nothing was listened to).
analysis.coverage: Full 30.0 s; every boundary; the image resolve and the shared-element move at 10-15 fps.

concept.observed: A product demo on an ivory canvas with warm gradient corners: a question, a chat panel where a prompt is typed, a grey placeholder that resolves into a generated photo, the photo moving into an email layout, the camera pulling back over the whole canvas, then the product wordmark.
concept.interpreted: Show the workflow, not the tool: one continuous canvas and a camera that frames each step make the demo feel effortless.

communication_style.observed: A centred question at the open, then one-line step captions in a dark pill; no voice.

palette.observed: Ivory canvas (#f8f8e8 45%, #f8f8f8 38%) with peach and sage gradient corners, white panels, dark-brown buttons, a green accent in the open and the logo; mean luma 0.91.

typography.observed: Medium grotesk question with one key phrase in green; small UI text; captions in white on a near-black pill.

camera.observed: A virtual camera pans and pushes across one large canvas: framing the chat (2.6-10 s), a push on the image (10.8-13.2 s), following the image into the email (17.6-18.7 s), push in (20.06 s), pan (22.69 s), pull back to the whole canvas (25.19 s).

transitions.observed: No cuts. Four soft boundaries, all camera moves on one canvas (continuous): 18.31 s the image travels as a shared element from the chat into the email hero while the camera follows (17.9-18.7 s; grow, container transform); 20.06 s push in on the email; 22.69 s pan; 25.19 s pull back. Not detected: 1.88 s the question rises and the UI enters from below (continuous); 26.62 s the UI fades to the empty ivory canvas, which holds about 0.4 s before the wordmark types on at 27.38 s (continuous, dip on the film's own background).
transitions.interpreted: A light canvas plus a camera replaces cuts; the dip before the logo uses the film's own background, never black.

sound_design.observed: -13.5 LUFS, LRA 5.3 LU, true peak +0.8 dBTP (above full scale); tempo estimate 74 bpm (medium); 62 accents (124/min) in a repeating 0.67 s / 0.42 s figure from 2.74 to 16.93 s and denser from 20.2 s; the listen frames show typing and small UI moves, not arrivals, on these accents, so they are the music's rhythm. 2 of 4 boundaries carry an accent (chance 0.34); all 4 are within 67 ms of an onset (chance 0.50, inflated by dense onsets); silence 0.05-1.02 s while the question fades in (head 21.6 dB below the body); tail +1.1 dB. Accents may be part of the music.
sound_design.interpreted: Music-led: a busy loop gives energy but no sound marks a step; the steps are marked by the caption pill instead.

narration.observed: None: dictation kept 0 words (41 raw words, all below the confidence cut, over a busy loop).
narration.interpreted: Text-led film: the copy is on screen, timed to the music.

captions.observed: Five step captions in a dark rounded pill at bottom centre (about 90% down): one line of 4-8 words in white sentence case, appearing as a whole line and held 3.5-5 s (cues at about 4.9, 11.6, 15.4, 20.6 and 25.9 s); no word highlight and no voice to sync to. The opening question is centred mid-frame with one key phrase in green.

scenes.observed: Chat panel: a prompt is typed and sent.
A grey placeholder resolves into a photo.
The image with the brand painted into the scene.
The image moves into the email layout; push in.
The email is shown; the camera pans and pulls back.
Dip to ivory; the wordmark types on; tagline and button.

moments.observed: A grey placeholder in the chat gets scattered warm patches (12.0-12.6 s) that spread until the photo resolves at 13.1 s, 2.2 s in all.
moments.interpreted: Generation is shown as a process, so the result feels earned.

moments.observed: The image scales from the chat bubble into the email hero over 0.8 s while the camera follows it; the old layout stays behind.

uncertainties: Whether the resolve is a real model's progressive output or designed
Whether the true-peak overshoot is in the delivered file or a decode artefact
